states: Actual App route passes authenticated security-status facts to the keyed Alerts configuration reader. Existing configuration owner, API adapters, destination editor and workspace-event producer consume only synthetic local endpoints.

Complete saved snapshot, partial denied read, explicit Retry, pending obsolete read, replacement workspace recovery, acknowledged save and pending old-policy write. Chromium desktop/light and WebKit narrow/dark; Playwright 1.56.1 matches the integration lock. Principal/token/capability equality and retirement are covered separately by registered page tests, not claimed as installed IdP proof.
interactions: 39 checks at 1280x900 and 390x844. Denied reads withdraw all destination details and Test controls; no fallback retry or configuration/test side effect from reading. Explicit recovery requires a complete fresh snapshot.

Obsolete reads are cancelled; current saved reads use no-store and expected workspace. Released old reads do not overwrite the new workspace. A single Save dispatches exactly policy/email/Apprise/watchdog once; old policy completion starts no destination writes or new success notice after replacement. Issued writes are not undone.

All eight viewport captures opened with native view_image. Desktop and narrow pixels show readable denial/retry with no old fields, then only tenant-b and tenant-c SMTP/webhook values. Crops do not show every editor control or prove provider/installed recovery.

Both browser contexts/engines, Vite and HTTP fixture close. No uncaught page errors. Earlier fixture error, two pending-read recovery failures and an overbroad old-toast assertion remain in retained evidence; the assertion now dismisses the earlier accepted save through its real Dismiss control before judging new feedback.
